summary.headline: Namkwang E&C wins KRW 55.9bn public housing contract in Pyeongtaek Godeok project
summary.what_happened: Namkwang Engineering & Construction signed a construction contract on Nov 26, 2026 for the Pyeongtaek Godeok A-70BL private-participation public housing project in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi-do, with Korea Land & Housing Corporation as the counterparty. The contract period runs from Nov 26, 2026 to Sep 30, 2030, with payment on a progress-payment basis and no advance payment.

key_numbers.label: Contract amount as % of recent revenue

summary.why_it_matters: Large supply or construction contract disclosures in Korea show the size of a company's newly won orders relative to its recent revenue, which can indicate future work volume. Such filings are typically made so shareholders can assess how a contract may affect a company's order backlog and business activity.
